title: Steam in the ice
briefing: White silence as far as the sensors reach. To the northeast, steam rises from a fissure. If the heat is stable, it can keep a colony alive. If not, we freeze.
goal: Measure the heat in the steam fissure and place a relay on the ice ridge.

main_sample.label: The Steam Fissure
main_sample.text: The heat is stable and comes from deep below. A generator here can give power day and night — and the water lies just under the ice.

risk_sample.label: The Moraine Block
risk_sample.text: The ice has pushed the block up from the depths. It's rich in iron and a little nickel. Not much, but enough to begin.

routes.label: Along the ice ridge
routes.description: Longer, but in the sun. The suit keeps warm.

routes.label: Across the shadow basin
routes.description: The direct route — through a pocket of cold, still air.

evacuation: The suit spends all its power keeping you warm. ARK: “Keep moving, Captain. Stay in the sun. The lander's cabin heating is on.”

findings.main: Nivalis: The steam fissure is stable. Geothermal first, then habitat.
findings.risk: Nivalis: The minerals are sparse, but they are there.
findings.relay: Nivalis: The relay on the ice ridge catches the low sun.
